question: Does the E108 matched-state response protocol remain numerically reliable across all cached atlas targets and observed downstream receiver pairs, excluding direct stimulated-cell responses?
parents: Same selected4d72ef33...3511f and stored parent47a369a1...2482d; exact full-state anchors copied from completed E108 with printed and saved hashes. No new settling/anchor selection.
fixed_trainable: All parameters and anchors fixed. No fitting, model/target reselection, random operations or physiological changes.
targets_pairs: All targets in hashed E106 cached statistics, recovered through recorded E107/E108 lineage; union of cached train/val/test observed pairs, excluding target==receiver. Unknown target/receiver identifiers fail preparation; missing coverage is not silently dropped. Direct self responses reported separately.
trials: Four existing E108 anchor phases, each target pulse0.5s at recorded amplitude/0mV reversal, horizon12s and fixed1ms recording. Neural steps0.25/0.125/0.0625/0.03125ms. Batches of8targets plus duplicate shams; last batch zero-padded and checked. Source anchors immutable; save full response means and compact sham RMD traces, not long all-cell or all-target voltage/state trajectories.
numerical_checks: Original vector criterion max-normalized error<0.1 and correlation>=0.9 on observed downstream pair vectors, separately each phase and phase mean. Also prospectively report per-pair mixed tolerance: abs(coarse-fine)<=1e-7 +0.1*max(abs(coarse),abs(fine));1e-7 is one tenth of the existing1e-6 model-response deadband, an engineering resolution convention, not experimental noise or physiology. Require all observed pairs and both finest successive comparisons for a declared check pass. Report worst pairs/fractions and sign changes for modeled responses at/above1e-6. No gate silently replaces an older criterion.
controls_audit: Automatic post-run audit: budget/execution, all batches/targets/grids/models, source/statistics/anchor/checkpoint/response hashes, full-state identity, immutable parameters, duplicate/padded shams and sham RMD persistence. Recompute scores from saved means. Source raw NWB files not re-read; cached statistics and data-evidence records hashed/copied. No optimizer/RNG state changed. Incomplete/timeout or hash failure cannot pass.
accuracy: Report frozen finest-grid phase-mean Spearman/AUC by original split descriptively, with numerical qualification status; no test-based reselection. Repeatedly inspected test split is not a new untouched holdout. No biological, body or sensory start/stop promotion.
resources: Two A100 workers, one fixed model per GPU; batches limit memory and saved output. Maximum120minutes TOTAL including automatic audit under nohup; may finish earlier.
